source.author: ov
source.text: Postquam plenissima fulsit et solida terras spectavit imagine luna, egreditur tectis vestes induta recinctas, nuda pedem, nudos umeris infusa capillos, fertque vagos mediae per muta silentia noctis incomitata gradus.
source.text_original: Postquam plenissima fulsit / et solida terras spectavit imagine luna, / egreditur tectis vestes induta recinctas, / nuda pedem, nudos umeris infusa capillos, / fertque vagos mediae per muta silentia noctis / incomitata gradus.
source.text_english: After the moon had shone at full and complete brightness and had looked down upon the earth with a perfect disk, she comes forth from her house, clothed in loosened garments, bare-footed, with her hair flowing over her bare shoulders, and, unattended, she bears her wandering steps through the silent stillness of the midmost night.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: et quem fama genus non est decepta Lyaei Phlias immissus patrios de vertice crines.
reuse.text_original: et quem fama genus non est decepta Lyaei / Phlias immissus patrios de vertice crines.
reuse.text_english: and Phlias, whom unerring rumor does not wrongly reckon among the family of Lyaeus, was sent down with his ancestral hair from the summit of his head.
